Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model.ships

Class Ship

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model.ships.Ship
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AircraftCarrier, Destroyer, Frigate, Submarine
public abstract class Ship extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a generic ship in the Battleship game. This abstract class defines the common properties and behavior shared by every ship type, including its size, orientation, occupied cells, and hit registration. Specific ship classes extend this class by providing their corresponding ShipType.

      public void occupy(Cell cell)
      Assigns a board cell to this ship. The specified cell becomes part of the ship, stores a reference to it, and changes its state to CellState.SHIP.
      Parameters:

    • registerHit

      public void registerHit()
      Registers a successful hit on the ship. Each invocation increases the number of hits received by one.

    • isSunk

      public boolean isSunk()
      Determines whether the ship has been sunk. A ship is considered sunk when the number of registered hits is equal to or greater than its size.
      Returns:
      true if the ship has been sunk; false otherwise
